scope: High-value open-source projects relevant to Windows hard-freeze diagnosis, evidence collection, hardware telemetry, EVTX analysis and PowerShell QA.

integrations.name: LibreHardwareMonitor
integrations.purpose: CPU/GPU/storage temperature, voltage, clocks, load and fan telemetry for pre-freeze sensor logging.

integrations.name: smartmontools
integrations.purpose: Deep SMART/ATA/NVMe health, error counters and self-test metadata through smartctl.

integrations.name: evtx / evtx_dump
integrations.purpose: Fast deterministic conversion of raw EVTX evidence to JSONL or XML for offline analysis.

integrations.name: Hayabusa
integrations.purpose: Forensics timeline generation and Sigma-based enrichment of Windows event logs.
integrations.notes: Runs as a separate optional process. The live-response package is preferred because upstream documents that encoded rules reduce antivirus alerts.

integrations.name: osquery
integrations.purpose: Structured read-only inventory of hardware, drivers, services, installed programs and OS state.

integrations.name: PerfView / TraceEvent
integrations.purpose: Advanced ETW CPU/memory/performance tracing for a later targeted capture stage.
integrations.notes: Crash Doctor deliberately does not start an ETW trace automatically because tracing changes workload and is a major experimental variable.

integrations.name: PSScriptAnalyzer
integrations.purpose: Static analysis and linting of Crash Doctor PowerShell sources.

integrations.name: Memtest86+
integrations.purpose: Boot-environment RAM testing independent of Windows.

integrations.name: CHIPSEC
integrations.purpose: Deep platform/firmware assessment for advanced escalation only.
integrations.notes: Never auto-installed or auto-run on a warranty machine.

integrations.name: Hardware.Info
integrations.notes: Useful if Crash Doctor moves to a compiled .NET core, but current PowerShell/CIM collection already covers most of its value.

integrations.name: Velociraptor
integrations.purpose: Full endpoint DFIR collection and orchestration.
integrations.notes: Powerful but far larger than the single-machine Crash Doctor scope; Hayabusa and local collectors cover the immediate need with less footprint.

integrations.name: Chainsaw
integrations.notes: Not imported because the former canonical repository currently redirects and evtx + Hayabusa already cover this role.
